traceability.evidence:
Implementation and tests clearly satisfy all requirements for docs/stories/009.0-DEV-MAINTENANCE-TOOLS.story.md.
1) Core maintenance APIs implemented - src/maintenance/index.ts - Exports all maintenance tools with explicit traceability: - detectStaleAnnotations (REQ-MAINT-DETECT) - updateAnnotationReferences (REQ-MAINT-UPDATE) - batchUpdateAnnotations, verifyAnnotations (REQ-MAINT-BATCH, REQ-MAINT-VERIFY) - generateMaintenanceReport (REQ-MAINT-REPORT) - JSDoc: - "@story docs/stories/009.0-DEV-MAINTENANCE-TOOLS.story.md" - "@req REQ-MAINT-DETECT/UPDATE/BATCH/VERIFY/REPORT/SAFE"
- src/maintenance/detect.ts - Function detectStaleAnnotations(codebasePath: string): string[] - Scans workspace root (resolved from cwd + codebasePath), enumerates files via getAllFiles, regex-scans for @story, and marks paths as stale if they’re in-project and missing on disk. - Security & safety: - Uses isUnsafeStoryPath + enforceProjectBoundary to avoid path traversal/absolute paths, satisfying maintenance safety concerns. - Returns [] when workspaceRoot doesn’t exist or isn’t a directory. - Wraps file reads and project-boundary checks in try/catch to avoid crashing. - Multiple helper functions with traceability: - processFileForStaleAnnotations, handleStoryMatch, getInProjectCandidates, anyInProjectCandidateExists. - All annotated with @story and @req REQ-MAINT-DETECT and REQ-MAINT-SAFE.
- src/maintenance/update.ts - updateAnnotationReferences(codebasePath, oldPath, newPath): number - Validates codebasePath exists and is a directory; returns 0 if not. - Escapes oldPath to a regex and replaces only the @story value: new RegExp((@story\s*)${escapedOldPath}, 'g'). - Uses a callback to keep the @story prefix intact and only change the path. - Writes back to file only when content changes, minimizing churn. - processFileForAnnotationUpdates helper encapsulates single-file logic. - All documented with @story and @req REQ-MAINT-UPDATE.
- src/maintenance/batch.ts - batchUpdateAnnotations(codebasePath, mappings): number - Iterates mappings and sums calls to updateAnnotationReferences. - @req REQ-MAINT-BATCH and REQ-MAINT-VERIFY. - verifyAnnotations(codebasePath): boolean - Calls detectStaleAnnotations and returns true if no stale annotations.
- src/maintenance/report.ts - generateMaintenanceReport(codebasePath): string - Calls detectStaleAnnotations. - Returns empty string when none, or newline-separated stale paths otherwise. - @req REQ-MAINT-REPORT and REQ-MAINT-SAFE.
- src/maintenance/utils.ts - getAllFiles(dir): string[] and traverseDirectory helper. - Validates dir exists and is directory; recursively collects only regular files. - Shared utility for maintenance tools, with traceability to 009.0 and internal REQ-MAINT-UTILS* IDs.
2) CLI integration and user experience - package.json - "bin": { "traceability-maint": "lib/src/maintenance/cli.js" } - Exposes maintenance CLI as traceability-maint.
- src/maintenance/cli.ts - runMaintenanceCli(rawArgv: string[]): number - Normalizes args via normalizeCliArgs/flags. - Dispatches to handleDetect/handleVerify/handleReport/handleUpdate based on subcommand. - If no command or -h/--help -> printHelp() and EXIT_OK. - Wraps dispatch in try/catch; on error logs "traceability-maint failed: ..." and returns EXIT_USAGE. - @req: REQ-MAINT-DETECT/VERIFY/REPORT/UPDATE/BATCH/SAFE. - printHelp(): prints usage, commands, and options, including --root, --json, --format, --from/--to, --dry-run.
- src/maintenance/commands.ts - EXIT_OK = 0, EXIT_STALE = 1, EXIT_USAGE = 2 (clear exit codes for UX and safety). - handleDetect - Parses flags, calls detectStaleAnnotations(root). - If --json: console.log({ root, stale }). - Else: logs "No stale @story annotations found." or each stale path + summary line. - Returns EXIT_OK when no stale, EXIT_STALE otherwise. - handleVerify - verifyAnnotations(root). - On success logs "All traceability annotations under are valid." and EXIT_OK. - On failure logs guidance including "Run 'traceability-maint detect' or 'traceability-maint report'..." and EXIT_STALE. - handleReport - generateMaintenanceReport(root). - If format=json: logs JSON { root, report }. - If no report: logs "No stale @story annotations found. Nothing to report.". - Else: prints titled report + stale references. - Always EXIT_OK. - handleUpdate - Validates flags.from and flags.to; if missing, prints error and returns EXIT_USAGE (REQ-MAINT-SAFE). - If --dry-run: logs a structured summary (JSON or text) and estimates stale before update; does not touch files. - Else: calls updateAnnotationReferences, logs count, returns EXIT_OK.
3) Documentation (Acceptance: Documentation) - README.md (lines ~109–151) - Section "Maintenance CLI": explains purpose and commands. - Lists commands: detect, verify, report, update. - Usage examples: - npx traceability-maint --help - detect/verify/report with --root - report --format json - update with --from and --to for renamed story files. - Points to user-docs/api-reference.md#maintenance-api-and-cli for full options and JSON payloads. - This directly satisfies the documentation acceptance criterion.
4) Tests for each requirement (behavior verified) All tests were run and passed with verbose output: - Command: npm test -- --ci --no-watch --runInBand --verbose - Result (from previous run): - Test Suites: 44 passed, 44 total - Tests: 330 passed, 330 total - Includes extensive coverage of Story 009.0.
Key tests for REQ-MAINT-DETECT - tests/maintenance/detect.test.ts - "[REQ-MAINT-DETECT] should return empty array when no stale annotations" (empty workspace). - "[REQ-MAINT-DETECT] should detect stale annotation references" (file with @story stale.story.md, no file on disk). - tests/maintenance/detect-isolated.test.ts - "[REQ-MAINT-DETECT] returns empty array when directory does not exist". - "[REQ-MAINT-DETECT] detects stale annotations in nested directories" – ensures recursive traversal. - "[REQ-MAINT-DETECT] performs security validation for unsafe and invalid-extension story paths without stat'ing outside workspace" – confirms unsafe paths are not checked on disk. - tests/perf/maintenance-large-workspace.test.ts - "[REQ-MAINT-DETECT] detectStaleAnnotations completes within a generous time budget" on a synthetic large workspace with many files and references. - tests/perf/maintenance-cli-large-workspace.test.ts - "[REQ-MAINT-DETECT] detect --json completes within a generous time budget and returns JSON payload" – validates CLI detect UX and performance. - tests/maintenance/cli.test.ts - "[REQ-MAINT-DETECT] detect exits with code 0 and message when no stale annotations". - "[REQ-MAINT-DETECT] detect supports --json output" – ensures JSON structure and stale list. - "[REQ-MAINT-DETECT] detect with non-existent --root exits 0 and reports no stale annotations".
Key tests for REQ-MAINT-UPDATE - tests/maintenance/update.test.ts - "[REQ-MAINT-UPDATE] should return 0 when no updates made". - tests/maintenance/update-isolated.test.ts - "[REQ-MAINT-UPDATE] updates @story annotations in files" – verifies path rewritten and count=1. - "[REQ-MAINT-UPDATE] should return 0 when directory does not exist". - tests/perf/maintenance-large-workspace.test.ts - "[REQ-MAINT-UPDATE] updateAnnotationReferences and batchUpdateAnnotations remain tractable" – performance guard on large workspaces. - tests/maintenance/cli.test.ts - "[REQ-MAINT-UPDATE] update performs replacements and exits 0" – end-to-end CLI flow. - "[REQ-MAINT-SAFE] dry-run does not modify files and exits 0" – verifies safety mode around updates.
Key tests for REQ-MAINT-BATCH & REQ-MAINT-VERIFY - tests/maintenance/batch.test.ts - batchUpdateAnnotations: - "[REQ-MAINT-BATCH] should return 0 when no mappings applied". - verifyAnnotations: - Sets up valid @story and story file; "[REQ-MAINT-VERIFY] should return true when annotations are valid". - tests/perf/maintenance-large-workspace.test.ts - "[REQ-MAINT-VERIFY] verifyAnnotations remains fast on large workspaces" and returns false when mixed valid+stale. - tests/perf/maintenance-cli-large-workspace.test.ts - "[REQ-MAINT-VERIFY] verify completes within a generous time budget and reports stale annotations" – CLI behavior. - tests/maintenance/cli.test.ts - "[REQ-MAINT-VERIFY] verify exits with code 0 when annotations valid". - "[REQ-MAINT-VERIFY] verify exits with code 1 and prints guidance when annotations are stale or invalid".
Key tests for REQ-MAINT-REPORT - tests/maintenance/report.test.ts - "[REQ-MAINT-REPORT] should return empty string when no operations". - "[REQ-MAINT-REPORT] should report stale story annotation" – ensures report includes missing story. - tests/maintenance/cli.test.ts - "[REQ-MAINT-REPORT] report prints human-readable summary and exits 0". - "[REQ-MAINT-REPORT] report prints 'nothing to report' when no stale annotations exist". - tests/perf/maintenance-large-workspace.test.ts - "[REQ-MAINT-REPORT] generateMaintenanceReport produces output within a generous time budget". - tests/perf/maintenance-cli-large-workspace.test.ts - "[REQ-MAINT-REPORT] report --format=json completes within a generous time budget" – verifies JSON output shape.
Key tests for REQ-MAINT-SAFE (safety, reversibility, error handling) - tests/maintenance/index.test.ts - Confirms all maintenance functions are exported from src/maintenance, supporting safe and discoverable API usage. - tests/maintenance/cli.test.ts - Argument validation and error handling: - "[REQ-MAINT-SAFE] update requires --from and --to and exits 2 when missing". - "[REQ-MAINT-SAFE] dry-run does not modify files and exits 0". - "[REQ-MAINT-SAFE] report exits 2 and prints error on invalid --format value" (via flags/commands logic). - "[REQ-MAINT-SAFE] prints help and exits 0 when no subcommand is provided". - "[REQ-MAINT-SAFE] detect catches filesystem permission errors and exits 2 with prefixed error message" (via runMaintenanceCli’s try/catch wrapping underlying FS errors). - src/maintenance/detect.ts and utils.ts implement safe handling of non-existing directories and potential boundary enforcement failures, supporting safety and reversibility guarantees.
5) Acceptance criteria mapping - Core Functionality - Detect stale annotations: detectStaleAnnotations + tests/maintenance/detect*.test.ts, tests/maintenance/cli.test.ts, tests/perf/*maintenance*. - Update references when files moved/renamed: updateAnnotationReferences, batchUpdateAnnotations, CLI `update` subcommand and associated tests. - Quality Standards - Updates operate only on @story path substrings and write only on change; tests confirm functional behavior (before/after content in update-isolated, CLI tests) and large-workspace perf tests guard against pathological behavior. - Integration - Maintenance tools share storyReferenceUtils and story paths with the core ESLint plugin, are exported from src/maintenance/index.ts, wired into package.json bin, and documented in README. - User Experience - CLI emits clear, human-readable messages, JSON payloads for automation, distinct exit codes, and has a detailed help message; all are asserted in tests/maintenance/cli.test.ts and perf CLI tests. - Error Handling - Non-existent roots -> empty results or EXIT_OK with "No stale ...". - Invalid format/options -> EXIT_USAGE + clear error. - Permission issues -> caught at CLI level with informative prefix. - Security on unsafe paths validated (no stat’ing outside workspace). - Documentation - README Maintenance CLI section and user-docs API reference link provide usage examples and best practices, including detect/verify/report/update workflows and JSON-mode usage.
Given the implemented code, extensive unit/integration/performance tests (all passing), CLI wiring, and README documentation, all listed requirements and acceptance criteria for Story 009.0-DEV-MAINTENANCE-TOOLS are satisfied.
traceability.notes: Story 009.0-DEV-MAINTENANCE-TOOLS is fully implemented. There is a complete set of maintenance APIs (detect, update, batch, verify, report), a dedicated CLI with clear UX and safety features, comprehensive tests tied to each requirement, performance validation on large workspaces, and user-facing documentation describing usage and integration. All tests for this story pass as part of the full Jest suite, so the story is considered PASSED.
